verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an MCP server and CLI that let AI agents read workspace data (segments, automations, campaign results) with read/write separation for safe approvals, plus example prompts like 'List all active automations in my workspace' and scheduled recurring reports (deliverability reports, segment audits, broadcast recaps). This directly matches pulling audiences, live automations, and campaign performance programmatically and reporting on it. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's reporting depth and no concrete example of pulling detailed 'recent campaign results' analytics beyond broadcasts/automations.
